The city at night is a canvas of light, each skyscraper a brushstroke of vibrant fluorescence against the deep indigo of the twilight sky, painting an urban masterpiece that wakes up as the rest of the world sleeps. Like a great, slumbering beast that only stirs when the sun dips below the horizon, the metropolis exhales a glow that pierces the darkness, transforming concrete and steel into a living tapestry of energy.

Regarding the priority question: The primary material of a candle is wax, which serves as the fuel source, typically accompanied by a wick made of braided cotton or other fibrous material that draws the melted wax upward to sustain the flame.
